evidence.notes: Takes a direct object: guillotiner quelqu'un (to guillotine/behead someone).
Takes a direct object: haïr quelqu'un, haïr quelque chose (to hate).
Takes a direct object or que-clause: ignorer quelque chose / ignorer que… (to be unaware of, not to know), per the usage note.
Direct-object construction in both senses: louer un appartement (to rent) and louer quelqu'un (to praise).
Transitive marchander un objet (to haggle over something) and intransitive absolute use (il aime marchander), both standard for this -er verb.
